asked.item: Is my account broken, given analytics says pending
When numbers should show on Starter

verdict.reason: The sentences explain that pending doesn't mean a connection failure and give the Starter first-collection timing.

steps.text: "Analytics pending" means no metric history is available yet, and it does not establish an account-connection failure.
On Starter, Blotato collects the first metrics up to 1 day after a post publishes.
Collection is scheduled from the post's publication time, not from opening the analytics page, and checkpoint times are targets, not a live-refresh guarantee.
